# TASK-021 Report job cadence

Status: ready

Outcome: the report job runs on the cadence set by the ruling cited below.

## Ruling reference

Handed over by the planning agent.

Reference
  Binding        mira
  Repository     example/mira-decisions
  ADR            0002
  Path           docs/adr/0002-reports-go-out-weekly.md
  Commit         1b9d588d594609270cd28d48306fe6ae0926b26c
  Digest         sha256:aea104d89bfefcc20ddc7fc7f60dd30e6ec3b20116f46fbde8b28e8997782b06

## Ruling update (agent, 2026-10-21)

The cited ADR 0002 (weekly) is not in force. Its digest matches the cited one, but it is Superseded by 0014, which is itself Superseded by 0023 (Accepted, example/mira-decisions docs/adr/0023-reports-go-out-daily-at-07-00.md, commit 1b9d588d594609270cd28d48306fe6ae0926b26c, decision key report-cadence). The ruling in force: the report job runs every day at 07:00 shop time. Cadence for this task: daily at 07:00 shop time (not weekly, not 06:00). The feature itself is not implemented yet.
